write_up: This is a strong FP&A resume! At Lakeshore Foods, you connect budget ownership, forecasting and pricing work to the business decisions they support. The move from plant reporting at Midway Brands to divisional FP&A tells a clear story.

The forecast line is the model to follow: it names what you built and shows how forecast error changed. Your current role also makes the budget and the people you present to clear, so a recruiter doesn't have to guess how the work fits into the division.

I'd make one small pass at the pricing line to show your part in the review. Your resume isn't likely to be the thing standing between you and a call back; the competition for a particular role will matter too.
